opening: My muscle weakness gets worse when I'm tired or stressed.
I have pain or weakness in my jaw.
Swallowing is difficult or feels uncomfortable or blocked.
I'm seeing double: two images of one thing, overlapping or side by side.
Someone in my family has been diagnosed with myasthenia gravis.

opening.text: I've been having some trouble lately. My muscle weakness gets worse when I'm tired or stressed, and I have pain or weakness in my jaw. Swallowing is difficult or feels uncomfortable or blocked. I'm also seeing double, like two images of one thing, overlapping or side by side. Oh, and someone in my family has been diagnosed with myasthenia gravis.
